r.name: King Alfred's Way
r.description: King Alfreds Way is 350km (220 miles) off road route designed to be ridden clockwise. It starts & ends in Winchester. It is suitable for gravel or cross-country bikes.

r.name: Watlington Hill Circular walk, Watlington Hill
r.description: This walk takes you onto the Oxfordshire Plain, along the ancient Icknield Way, before ascending the Chiltern Escarpment through Greenfield Copse. Walk across several valleys of the Chilterns to Watlington Hill. Several short steep gradients.

r.name: A long walk in the Chilterns, Central Chilterns
r.description: This 16-mile challenging circular drops down & along the Chilterns Escarpment & climbs back into the hills. Visit pretty hamlets & the Stonor & Wormsley estates. Enjoy much remote, unspoiled countryside &woodland. Steep gradients, several stiles.

r.name: Woodland Walk, Basildon Park
r.description: This route goes through the woodland and across our landscape parkland. Suitable for all terrain pushchairs. Potential for livestock on route.

r.name: Hidden Valley, Basildon Park
r.description: A route throught our secluded valley, down the carriage drive and up the old drive to the mansion. Potential for livestock on route.

r.name: Boundary Walk, Basildon Park
r.description: Around the boundary of the parkland, this route includes the oldest trees at the properties. Suitable for all terrain pushchairs. Potential for livestock on route.

r.name: Meadows and Woodlands of Streatley Walk, Goring Gap
r.description: This circular around the meadows & woodlands of Goring Gap forms the backdrop to Streatley village. Visit one of Britain’s largest areas of rare chalk grassland & get panoramic views of the Chilterns, North Wessex Downs & Oxford Vale & the River Thames.

r.name: West Berkshire Countryside Walk, Goring Gap
r.description: Enjoy this circular spanning Lardon Chase, the Holies & Lough Down. Explore a variety of landscapes, spot rare butterflies & admire views of the Chiltern Hills, North Wessex Downs & Goring Gap. Sections may be challenging for people with reduced mobility.
